arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ،
transliteration: allāhumma yā man lā yarghabu fīl-jazāʾi
english_text: O God, O He who desires no repayment!

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَنْدَمُ عَلَى الْعَطَآءِ،
transliteration: walā yandamu ʿalā al-ʿaṭāʾ
english_text: O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهُ عَلَى السَّوآءِ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā yukāfiʾu ʿabdahu ʿalā al-sawāʾi
english_text: O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!

arabic_text: مِنَّتُكَ ابْتِدَاءٌ، وَعَفْوُكَ تَفَضُّلٌ، وَعُقُوبَتُكَ عَـدْلٌ، وَقَضَاؤُكَ خِيَرَةٌ،
transliteration: min natuka ibtidā'un, wa'afwuka tafadhdhulun waʿuqūbatuka ʿadlun, waqaḍāʾuka khīyaratun
english_text: Thy kindness is a new beginning, Thy pardon gratuitous bounty, Thy punishment justice, Thy decree a choice for the best!

arabic_text: إنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَآءَكَ بِمَنٍّ، وَإنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّيا
transliteration: in ʾin ʾaʿṭayta lam tashub ʿaṭāʾaka bimannin wa in manʿta lam yakun manaʿuka taʿaddin
english_text: If Thou bestowest, Thou stainest not Thy bestowal with obligation, and if Thou withholdest, Thou withholdest not in transgression.

arabic_text: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَأَنْتَ أَلْهَمْتَهُ شُكْرَكَ،
transliteration: tashkur man shakaraka wa anta alhamtahu shukraka
english_text: Thou showest gratitude to him who thanks Thee, while Thou hast inspired him to thank Thee.

arabic_text: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهُ حَمْدَكَ،
transliteration: wa tukāfiʾu man ḥamidak wa anta ʿallamtahu ḥamdak
english_text: Thou rewardest him who praises Thee, while though Thou hast taught him Thy praise.

arabic_text: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهُ وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهُ،
transliteration: tasturu ʿala man law shi'ta faḍaḥtahu wa tajūdu ʿalā man law shiʾta manʿtahu
english_text: Thou coverest him whom, if Thou willed, Thou wouldst expose, and Thou art generous toward him from whom, if Thou willed, Thou wouldst withhold.

arabic_text: وَكِلاَهُمَا أَهْلٌ مِنْكَ لِلْفَضِيحَةِ وَالْمَنْعِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ أَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ، وَأَجْرَيْتَ قُدْرَتَكَ عَلَى التَّجَاوُزِ، وَتَلَقَّيْتَ مَنْ عَصَاكَ بِالحِلْمِ،
transliteration: wa-kilāhumā ahlu minka li-lfadhihah wa-lman'ِ ġayra annaka banayta afʿālaka ʿalā tafadḍul waʾajrayta qudrataka ʿalā al-tajāwuzi wa talqaayta man ʿasāka bilḥilm
english_text: Both are worthy of Thy exposure and withholding, but Thou hast founded Thy acts upon gratuitous bounty, channelled Thy power into forbearance, received him who disobeyed Thee with clemency,

arabic_text: وَأمْهَلْتَ مَنْ قَصَدَ لِنَفْسِهِ بِالظُّلْمِ
transliteration: wa-amhaltu man qasada linafsihi bilẓulm
english_text: and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.

arabic_text: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِأناتِكَ إلى الإنَابَةِ وَتَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ إلَى التَّوْبَةِ لِكَيْلاَ يَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ هَالِكُهُمْ، وَلا يَشْقَى بِنِعْمَتِكَ شَقِيُّهُمْ إلاَّ عَنْ طُولِ الإِعْذَارِ إلَيْهِ،
transliteration: tastanẓiruhum bi'anatika ila al-inabati wa tatruku mu'ajalatahum ila al-tawba li-kayla yahlika ʿalayka haalikuhum walā yashqā binʿamati-ka shaqīyuhum illa ʿan ṭūl al-iʿḏār ilayhi
english_text: Thou awaitest their turning back without haste and refrainest from rushing them toward repentance, so that the perisher among them may not perish because of Thee and the wretched may not be wretched through Thy favour, but only after Thy prolonged excusing him

arabic_text: وَبَعْدَ تَرَادُفِ الْحُجَّةِ عَلَيْهِ كَرَماً مِنْ عَفْوِكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ، وَعَائِدَةً مِنْ عَطْفِكَ يَا حَلِيمُ.
transliteration: wa baʿda tarādufi al-ḥujjati ʿalayhi karāman min ʿafwikā yā karīm waʿāʾidatan min ʿatfika yā ḥalīm
english_text: and successive arguments against him, as an act of generosity through Thy pardon, O Generous, and an act of kindliness through Thy tenderness, O Clement!

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ فَتَحْتَ لِعِبَادِكَ بَاباً إلَى عَفْوِكَ وَسَمَّيْتَهُ التَّوْبَـةَ،
transliteration: anta alladhī fataḥta li-ʿibādika bāban 'ilā 'afwik wa sammaytahu attawbah'
english_text: It is Thou who hast opened for Thy servants a door to Thy pardon, which Thou hast named 'repentance'.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذلِكَ البَابِ دَلِيلاً مِنْ وَحْيِكَ لِئَلاَّ يَضِلُّوا عَنْهُ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ : (تُوبُوا إلَى الله تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُكَفِّـرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ
transliteration: wa jaʿalt ʿalā dhālika al-bābi dalīlan min wahyika liʾallā yaḍillū ʿanhū faqultu tabāraka asmuka tuubuu ilaa allahi tawbatan nasuuhan 'asaa rabbukum 'an yukaffira 'ankum sayyiatikum wa yudkhilakum
english_text: Thou hast placed upon that door a pointer from Thy revelation, lest they stray from it: Thou hast said (blessed is Thy Name), "Repent toward God with unswerving repentance! It may be that Thy Lord will acquit of your evil deeds and will admit you into

arabic_text: جَنَّات تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لاَ يُخْزِي اللهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
transliteration: jannāt tajrī min taḥtiha al-anhār yawma lā yukhzī allāhu an-nabiyّa wa-al-latheena amanoo ma'ahu nooruhum yas'aa bayna aydeehim wabi-a'manihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā waghfir lanā
english_text: gardens beneath which rivers flow, upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet and those who have faith along with him, their light running before them and on their right hands, and they say: 'Our Lord, complete for us our light, and forgive us!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ)
transliteration: 'innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeerun
english_text: Surely Thou art powerful over everything" (66:8).

arabic_text: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ ذلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ بَعْدَ فَتْحِ الْبَابِ وَإقَامَةِ الدَّلِيْلِ،
transliteration: fa mā ʿudhr man aghfala dukhūla dhālika al-manzil baʿda fatḥi al-bābi wa iqāmati al-dalīl
english_text: What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering that house after the opening of the door and the setting up of the pointer?

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي زِدْتَ فِي السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ تُرِيدُ رِبْحَهُمْ فِي مُتَاجَرَتِهِمْ لَكَ، وَفَوْزَهُمْ بِالْوِفَادَةِ عَلَيْكَ وَالزِّيادَةِ مِنْكَ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ:
transliteration: wa anta alladhi zidta fi al-sawmi ʿala nafsika li ʿibadik turīdu ribhahum fī mutājaratihim laka wa fawzahum bilwifadati ʿalayka walziyadati minka faqulta tabāraka asmuka wa taʿālayta:
english_text: It is Thou who hast raised the price against Thyself to the advantage of Thy servants, desiring their profit in their trade with Thee, their triumph through reaching Thee, and their increase on account of Thee, for Thou hast said (blessed is Thy Name and high art Thou exalted),

arabic_text: (مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلاَ يُجْزى إلاّ مِثْلَهَا)
transliteration: man jaa'a bil-ḥasanati falahu ʿashru ʾamthālihā wa-man jaa'a bil-sayyiati falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa
english_text: "Whoso brings a good deed shall have ten the like of it, and whoso brings an evil deed shall only be recompensed the like of it" (6:160).

arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ: (مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ الله كَمَثَلِ حَبَّة أَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَة مَائَةُ حَبَّة
transliteration: waqulta: (mathalu alladheena yunfiqoona amwalahum fi sabili allahi kama mathali habbati) 'anbatat sab'a sanabil fi kulli sunbulah mi'atu habbah
english_text: Thou hast said, "The likeness of those who expend their wealth in the way of God is as the likeness of a grain of corn that sprouts seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains;

arabic_text: وَالله يُضَاعِفُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ)
transliteration: wa-allahu yuda'ifu liman yasha'u
english_text: so God multiplies unto whom He wills" (2:261).

arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ: (مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يُقْرِضُ الله قَرْضاً حَسَنَاً فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ أضْعَافاً كَثِيرَةً)
transliteration: wa qult: "man dha alladhi yuqridhullāh qardhan hasanā" fayuḍāʿifahu lahu aḍʿāfān kathīrah
english_text: Thou hast said, "Who is he that will lend to God a good loan, and He will multiply it for him manifold" (2:245)?

arabic_text: وَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
transliteration: wama anzalta min nadhāʾirihinna fīl-qur'āni min taḍāʿīfi al-ḥasanāt
english_text: And Thou hast sent down in the Qur'an similar verses on the multiplying of good deeds.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَتَرْغِيْبِكَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهُ عَنْهُمْ لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَعِـهِ أَسْمَاعُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَلْحَقْـهُ أَوْهَامُهُمْ
transliteration: wa anta allaḏī dalaltahum biqawlika min ghaybika wa tarġībika alladhī fīhi ḥaẓẓuhum ʿalā mā law satartahu ʿanhum lam tudrikhu abṣāruhum wa lam taʿihi asmāʾuhum wa lam talhaqhu aw'hamuhum
english_text: It is Thou who hast pointed them through Thy speech from Thy Unseen and Thy encouragement in which lies their good fortune toward that which - hadst Thou covered it from them their eyes would not have perceived, their ears would not have heard, and their imaginations would not have grasped,

arabic_text: فَقُلْتَ: (اذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِيْ وَلا تَكْفُرُونِ)
transliteration: faqultu: (udhkuruni adhkurkum wa ashkuru li wa la takfuruni)
english_text: for Thou hast said, "Remember Me and I will remember you be thankful to Me, and be you not thankless towards Me" (2:152)!

arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ: (لَئِنْ شَكَـرْتُمْ لازِيدَنَّكمْ وَلَئِنْ كَفَـرْتُمْ إنَّ عَذابِيْ لَشَدِيدٌ)
transliteration: wa qulta: "la'in shakartum lazidannakum." wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabī lashadīd
english_text: Thou hast said, "If you are thankful, surely I will increase you, but if you are thankless, My chastisement is surely terrible" (14:7);

arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ : (ادْعُونِيْ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ)
transliteration: wa qulta: (idʿūnī astajib lakum) inna allatheena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibadati sayadkhulun jahannama dakhireen
english_text: And Thou hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you, surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Gehenna utterly abject" (40:60).

arabic_text: فَسَمَّيْتَ دُعَاءَكَ عِبَادَةً، وَتَرْكَهُ اسْتِكْبَاراً، وَتَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهِ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ،
transliteration: fa-sammayta du'āka ʿibādah, wa-tarkahu istikbāran wa tawaʿaddta ʿalā tarkih dukhūl al-jahannama dākhilīna
english_text: Hence Thou hast named supplicating Thee 'worship' and refraining from it 'waxing proud', and Thou hast threatened that the refraining from it would yield entrance into Gehenna in utter abjection.

arabic_text: فَذَكَرُوكَ بِمَنِّكَ وَشَكَرُوكَ بِفَضْلِكَ، وَدَعَوْكَ بِأَمْرِكَ، وَتَصَدَّقُوا لَكَ طَلَباً لِمَزِيدِكَ،
transliteration: faḏakaruka bimannika wa shakaruka bifadlik wa daʿawka bi-amrika wa taṣaddaqū lak(a) ṭalaban limazīdik(a)
english_text: So they remember Thee for Thy kindness, they thank Thee for Thy bounty, they supplicate Thee by Thy command, and they donate for Thee in order to seek Thy increase;

arabic_text: وَفِيهَا كَانَتْ نَجَاتُهُمْ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ، وَفَوْزُهُمْ بِرِضَاكَ،
transliteration: wa-fiha kānat najātuhum min ghadabika wa fawzuhum bi-riḍāka
english_text: in all this lies their deliverance from Thy wrath and their triumph through Thy good pleasure.
